concept: DR strategies: backup & restore — lowest cost with RTO in hours
tests: Choosing a DR strategy for a non-critical app with an RTO of several hours and a minimal budget.
expected: Backup and restore — backups are stored, infrastructure is deployed on demand; the cheapest option. Triggers: "non-critical", "RTO of several hours", "low budget", "simplest".
why_not: Pilot light and warm standby keep some resources running — more expensive; multi-site active-active — the most expensive, overkill.
